decided_by: human annotator (visual), corroborated by a pixel-only source audit

violated_rule.predeclared: 300 continuous native-FPS frames, no camera/broadcast cut, >=10 mean humans/frame over the full window

discontinuity_in_the_window.transition_type: dissolve, not a hard cut -- the change is spread over ~17 frames, so no adjacent frame pair looks catastrophic and a lag-1 hard-cut rule sails past it

evidence.broadcast_clock_burn_in: src 391-393 read 29:0x; src 394 reads 30:35 -- a jump of about 1.5 minutes to a different game moment
evidence.pixel_signal: histogram correlation at lag 8 falls to 0.80-0.85 through the transition against a source median of 0.9987
evidence.visual: different attacking phase and camera position after the transition; frame 394 shows dissolve ghosting

discontinuity_in_the_window.note: Neither side reaches 300 frames, so this window cannot be salvaged by trimming.

source_verdict.finding: The Austin source video is a highlights/recap montage, not a continuous broadcast.
source_verdict.control: The same rule applied unchanged to the other three VAL sources found ZERO discontinuities in each (bayern, women_1, youth; 1501 frames each, hcorr p5 >= 0.9867).
source_verdict.prior_signal_in_repo: tools/build_temporal_val.py already carried a note that an earlier Austin sample landed 'entirely inside a goalkeeper close-up that also contained a camera cut'. The signal existed in an earlier phase and was not generalised to tracking-window selection.

clean_island_exists_but_not_used.why_not_used: Instructed not to hunt for a lucky clean island inside a generally discontinuous source. A window selected by surviving a cut detector calibrated on one event carries the risk that a slower dissolve was missed, and a benchmark whose windows were chosen by that search is only as trustworthy as the search.

annotation_work_preserved.purpose: provenance and evidence of where annotation stopped

where_human_work_stops.clarified_by: the human annotator, and confirmed against the export
where_human_work_stops.annotator_statement: manual work continued only to approximately package frame 115, stopping at the discovered broadcast transition
where_human_work_stops.what_the_residual_boxes_are: CVAT continues a track that has no further keyframes by holding the last keyframed shape. All 3,184 boxes after package frame 101 are byte-identical copies of that track's frame-101 box, frozen in place for 199 frames. They are neither annotation nor motion.
where_human_work_stops.verification: Checked directly in the export: 16/16 tracks have every post-101 box identical to their frame-101 box, and zero boxes after CVAT frame 100 carry keyframe="1".

annotation_work_preserved.identity_validity: Frames 1-101 are human annotation of a pre-transition scene. Frames 102-300 are NOT annotation: they are residual CVAT hold from pre-transition tracks and must not be used as GT. The annotator did not assert, and the file does not represent, physical identity continuity across the transition.

correction_of_an_earlier_statement.what_was_recorded_before: that the 16 tracks 'run unbroken across all 300 frames with no outside markers, so every identity was carried across the transition'
correction_of_an_earlier_statement.why_that_was_wrong: It read a tool artifact as a human claim. The annotator stopped at the transition; CVAT's hold behaviour produced the rest. Nobody asserted that a post-cut person is a pre-cut person.

future_use.usable_for: measuring how a tracker behaves across an edit -- how many identities it destroys, whether it invents continuity that does not exist
future_use.not_usable_for: any clean-continuity metric, and never aggregated with the clean sequences
if_reused: Rebuild the pre-cut and post-cut annotation spaces from the ORIGINAL VIDEO. Do not treat the current post-101 boxes as annotation of anything; they are frozen residue.
Give the two sides INDEPENDENT identity spaces, unless a separate and explicitly defined re-identification GT is created manually.
Frames 1-101 are reusable human work for the pre-cut side and need not be redrawn; frames 102-300 must be annotated from scratch.
future_use.raw_export_is_immutable: The CVAT export is kept exactly as downloaded. Corrections belong in this record, not in the evidence.
